name: cockpit
description: Mission control, redone: moonlit glass over Dahl's Dresden at night, a New Tab page with a greeting, live counters that roll when they change, launch tiles and three designed cards (what needs you, your PRs, your workspaces), a Needs You section on top of the sidebar, the session tree, Priority View and a docked Chief on the right.

files.themes/last-demo-cockpit.json:
// Cockpit: moonlit glass. Dahl's Dresden by moonlight behind clear glass, a deep night-blue
// sidebar, an ice-blue accent with amber for what waits on you. The New Tab page is the most
// see-through surface, so the cockpit's cards float over the painting.
{
  "name": "Cockpit",
  "description": "Moonlit glass over Dresden at night; an ice-blue accent, amber for what waits on you.",

  "appearance.theme": "TokyoNight",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#0d1320",
    "foreground": "#dde6f5",
    "cursor": "#7cc7ff",
    "selection": "#1f3150",
    "accent": "#7cc7ff",
    "1": "#ff7a90",
    "2": "#6fe3b4",
    "3": "#ffc46b",
    "4": "#7cc7ff",
    "5": "#b9a3ff",
    "6": "#5fd7e8"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The painting, through clear glass: the desktop's blur under it, a little of it showing.
  "appearance.background": "dahl-dresden-moonlight",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.78,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.35,

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "floating",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#0a0f1a",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.7,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",

  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#0d1320",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.86,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#0d1320",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.88,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#0d1320",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.5,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#7cc7ff"

}
